# GitHub-only blog pages

This folder stores article HTML files in the repository without adding them to the public website navigation.

To add another pasted page:

1. Copy `new-post-template.html`.
2. Rename the copy with a clear slug, for example `steel-connection-notes.html`.
3. Paste the article HTML into the copied file.
4. Commit and push the file to GitHub.

The current imported article is `fea_abaqus_notes.html`.
